title: Triangulated category and exact functor
statement: A *pre-triangulated category* is an additive category $\mathcal T$ with an additive automorphism $[1]:\mathcal T\to\mathcal T$ (the *shift*; write $[n]$ for its $n$-th power, $n\in\mathbf Z$) and a class of *distinguished triangles* $X\xrightarrow{u}Y\xrightarrow{v}Z\xrightarrow{w}X[1]$ satisfying: (TR1) every triangle isomorphic to a distinguished one is distinguished, $X\xrightarrow{\mathrm{id}}X\to0\to X[1]$ is distinguished, and every morphism $u:X\to Y$ is the first arrow of some distinguished triangle $X\xrightarrow{u}Y\to Z\to X[1]$ (a *cone triangle* of $u$, $Z$ a *cone* of $u$); (TR2) $X\xrightarrow{u}Y\xrightarrow{v}Z\xrightarrow{w}X[1]$ is distinguished if and only if its rotation $Y\xrightarrow{v}Z\xrightarrow{w}X[1]\xrightarrow{-u[1]}Y[1]$ is; (TR3) given two distinguished triangles $(X,Y,Z,u,v,w)$, $(X',Y',Z',u',v',w')$ and morphisms $a:X\to X'$, $b:Y\to Y'$ with $b\circ u=u'\circ a$, there is $c:Z\to Z'$ with $c\circ v=v'\circ b$ and $a[1]\circ w=w'\circ c$ (a *morphism of triangles*). A *triangulated category* is a pre-triangulated category satisfying moreover (TR4, the octahedral axiom): for composable $u:X\to Y$, $v:Y\to Z$ and distinguished cone triangles of $u$, $v$ and $v\circ u$ with cones $C_u$, $C_v$, $C_{vu}$, there are morphisms $C_u\to C_{vu}\to C_v$ making the evident diagram commute and forming, with the composite $C_v\to Y[1]\to C_u[1]$, a distinguished triangle $C_u\to C_{vu}\to C_v\to C_u[1]$. An additive functor $F:\mathcal T\to\mathcal T'$ between pre-triangulated categories equipped with a natural isomorphism $F(X[1])\cong F(X)[1]$ is *exact* (triangulated) if it carries distinguished triangles to distinguished triangles.
